summary: Drift detection, impact, regression, interactions, and the analyze aggregate over cards plus code state.

domain.overview:
Owns analytical reads on top of card and code state. Detects six drift types
(broken_link, boundary_inactive, symbol_changed, heritage_uncovered, pattern_violation,
glossary_broken), drives automatic active-to-drifted status transitions when configured,
computes impact and risk_level for proposed file changes, evaluates regression thresholds,
surfaces interaction conflicts between cards that share code, and aggregates the overall
analyze health view consumed by onboarding and dashboards.
domain.scope:
IN: checkDrift, checkInteractions, preChangeCheck, regressionGuard, analyze, drift type
classification, automatic status transitions on drift, risk_level computation, shared-symbol
conflict detection.

OUT: applying drift fixes (delegated to card-lifecycle plus code-binding), CLI presentation.

cross_domain_dependencies.relationship: consumes link-resolution and pattern evaluation outputs to classify drift.
reads card state through repositories to compute aggregates.
